command:
docker rm -f riccon-mysql-1419 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name riccon-mysql-1419 --network none -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=probe_root_only -e MYSQL_DATABASE=probe -e MYSQL_USER=probe -e MYSQL_PASSWORD=probe_only mysql:8.4.13 >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  if docker exec -e MYSQL_PWD=probe_only riccon-mysql-1419 mysql -uprobe probe -e "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=$((ready + 1))
    [ "$ready" -ge 3 ] && break
  else
    ready=0
  fi
  sleep 2
done
echo "probe server stable after ${i} checks"
docker exec -e MYSQL_PWD=probe_only riccon-mysql-1419 mysql -uprobe probe -e "SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log_bin_trust_function_creators'; CREATE TABLE probe_t (id INT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TRIGGER trg_probe BEFORE UPDATE ON probe_t FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'nope';"
rc=$?
docker rm -f riccon-mysql-1419 >/dev/null
exit $rc
note: 反向对照（期望失败，替代 EV-0133）：同版本 MySQL 8.4.13、同权限用户，未加参数时创建触发器报 ERROR 1419
